rounds.text: Koiya International Ltd displays exceptional capital efficiency where it counts most, generating a stellar Return on Equity (ROE) of 32.68% compared to the sector benchmark of 6.46% [E7]. This superior profitability is mirrored by a matching ROCE of 32.68%, vastly outperforming the sector benchmark of 8% and the sector median of 7.7% [E8, E32]. This core operational strength is backed by robust top-line momentum, highlighted by a powerful 34% year-over-year sales surge that easily outpaces the sector median sales growth of 8% [E23, E31]. Furthermore, recent fundamental catalysts show tangible operational momentum, specifically accelerating earnings growth alongside quarter-on-quarter profit increases [E25, E26]. Long-term patient investors have also been rewarded through compounding share price growth of 15% over a 10-year horizon [E10]. Conceded: [E13], [E14], [E16].

Koiya International Ltd carries severe fundamental and operational risks that make its current micro-cap status of ₹ 4.81 Cr precarious [E1]. The company's market momentum has completely collapsed, with the stock sitting merely 10% of the way up its 52-week range near its low of 7 against a high of 20 [E3], driving a precipitous 1-year share price decline of -62% [E13] and a 3-year contraction of -27% [E12]. Profitability metrics are deeply alarming, underscored by a catastrophic net profit collapse of -100% YoY [E27] and a staggering Return on Assets (ROA) of -107.41% compared to a sector benchmark of 3.07% [E6]. Operational deterioration is further confirmed by the quarterly operating margin shrinking to 1% in Dec 2013 from 15% in the year-ago quarter, representing a sharp 14 percentage point drop [E14]. Compounding these headwinds, insiders are actively retreating, with promoter holding falling to a low 13.83% as of Jun 2026 from 21.61% in Sep 2023 [E16], accompanied by a flagged negative quarterly decrease of -7.79% [E20]. Conceded: [E7].

Conceded: [E3], [E6], [E12], [E13], [E14], [E16], [E20], and [E27]. Despite these near-term struggles, the bear ignores powerful structural profitability and growth catalysts, highlighted by an exceptional ROE of 32.68% that obliterates the sector benchmark of 6.46% [E7] and a ROCE of 32.68% that massively outperforms the sector's 8% [E8]. Far from a broken business, the rules-based screen detects active underlying demand through robust sales growth of +34% YoY [E23], strong core sales expansion [E24], accelerating earnings growth [E26], and profit expanding on a QoQ basis [E25]. This operational vitality is paired with long-term compound share price growth of 15% over 10 years and 14% over 5 years [E10, E11], proving the company creates substantial value across economic cycles. Furthermore, institutional money flow sits at a neutral stance rather than wholesale flight [E17], and the valuation is supported by a clean bias check showing no major red-flags in momentum or macro consistency [E28].

Conceded: [E7], [E8], [E10], [E11], [E23], [E24], [E25], [E26], and [E28]. While the bull points to high historical share price growth and strong recent top-line expansion, these metrics are completely undermined by catastrophic near-term share price collapses of -62% over 1 year and -27% over 3 years [E12, E13]. Furthermore, the claim of operational vitality is directly contradicted by a verified net profit crash of -100% YoY [E27] and a severe operating margin compression of -14 percentage points down to just 1% [E14]. The assertion of fundamental strength via high ROE and ROCE [E7, E8] is rendered highly questionable by a deeply distressed ROA of -107.41% [E6] and negative price-to-earnings and price-to-book multiples [E4, E5]. Finally, the bull's dismissal of insider confidence ignores the sharp drop in promoter ownership down to a weak 13.83% [E16, E21], accompanied by explicit negative flags regarding ongoing promoter dilution [E20].
